Jules (People Ops): Quick heads-up — please join me in welcoming Emma Li, starting Monday 6/10 as Staff ML Engineer on Eng-ML. Emma will be joining Ravi's team and will focus on runtime & model lifecycle for Redwood Private (latency, quantization, KV cache work). Short bio: previously led inference infra at Satori, built quantized kernels at Optiv. :tada:

Matt (CEO): Fantastic — welcome Emma! excited to have you onboard :rocket:

Ravi Patel: Super excited. Quick org note: we'll split Eng-ML into two pods next week — runtime (latency, kernels, quant) and platform (deploy, rollouts). Emma will land in runtime and be the IC lead. I'll post a short org chart and transition plan later today.

Emma Li: Hi all! really excited to join Redwood. Happy to jump into the latency backlog and run an onboarding sync with anyone who wants to pair. Prefers async for scheduling but open to short syncs. :) 

Jules (People Ops): Emma's onboarding checklist updated and calendar invites sent. Welcome lunch on Wed 12pm in HQ kitchen (remote folks we'll set up a virtual table). :bento:

Sara (People Ops): FYI badge and laptop provisioning in progress. @emma you'll get access to staging GPUs by EOD tomorrow. 

Alex Chen: @Emma I'll add you to the staging infra channel and share the terraform snippets for GPU pools. If you need immediate access ping me and I'll grant 2-hour tokens. 

Ravi Patel: Also heads-up — we're opening a backfill req for the inference infra lead (IC4-IC5) to support dedicated/private scaling. Hiring plan will be out in the next All Hands. 

onboard-bot: Emma Li added to Slack, GitHub org, and GSuite. Welcome pack emailed. :white_check_mark:

Jules (People Ops): Thanks everyone — please drop a quick welcome or react to this thread so Emma sees the team. @emma see you on Monday! :wave:
